notes: Entries are added before implementation and are never renumbered (docs/technical/91-verification-strategy.md § Verification registry). Every entry below was authored before the production code it names.

'status' takes exactly one of 'registered', 'implemented', 'retired' (doc 91 § Entry status). 'evidenceKinds' is read against 'status' (doc 91 § What evidenceKinds means): for a 'registered' entry the list is evidence the verification will produce once built, and nothing may treat it as produced.
The structural validator for this file is owned by TASK-FND-009-002. Until it lands, the shape here matches tests/verification/PLY-001.json exactly.

This file is deliberately NOT named SIM-0*.json. tests/MechaMiner.Simulation.Tests/Support/NegativeControlCoverageTests.cs globs 'SIM-0*.json' and asserts a totals line accounting for every entry across those seven files, so adding an entry to one of them from another work package would break an unrelated package's gate.

Negative controls for these entries are recorded in tests/verification/M3-negative-controls.md. No automated gate asserts that document's coverage: the existing coverage gate (NegativeControlCoverageTests) is scoped to the seven SIM registries and its partition arithmetic is over those files only. That is stated here so a reader does not assume an enforcement that does not exist.

This slice implements one of the four accepted mining-point classes: the standard ore seam of docs/40 § Standard ore seams. Rich seams differ only in two numbers and add no behaviour; material geodes and Hyper Gold sites both withhold their reward until completion and both carry a second mechanic (resonance fields, progress-threshold threat beacons) that docs/110:283 assigns to MIN-002. Entries for those are MIN-002's.

The extraction-zone radius is graybox with no source claimed. docs/40:48, docs/decisions/DEC-031:51, and docs/10:75 each say the exact radius remains open in OQ-004, and no document in this branch's ancestry states one. src/MechaMiner.Simulation/Mining/GrayboxExtraction.cs isolates the value and says so. No entry below asserts the radius; VER-MIN-001-002 asserts the occupancy RULE against whatever the radius is.

entries.summary: The standard-ore-seam profile equals the authored payout profile: 10 common ore per completed 1.5-second installment, ten installments, and therefore 100 ore over 15 seconds of uninterrupted forward extraction, with the installment landing on a whole number of 60 Hz ticks.

Extraction is automatic and proximity-driven with no command: entering the circular zone advances progress on the tick occupancy begins, remaining inside advances it every tick, the boundary test is inclusive at exact tangency, and a depleted seam advances nothing and cannot be reactivated.

Leaving the zone holds unfinished progress unchanged for exactly 0.5 seconds and then removes it at four times the forward rate until it reaches zero; re-entering during either resumes from the progress that remains; and an already-paid installment is never reduced by any amount of decay.

Each completed installment pays its ore into the run-local total in phase 11 and nowhere else, one installment at most per tick, and the total after ten installments is the 100 ore the seam's profile states.
